# ReShiki 0.17.0

This release brings catalytic cycles, figure panels and connected lab equipment
to the drawing canvas, makes Properties follow your selection, and streamlines
GitHub browsing and figure export.

- **Catalytic cycles.** Turn selected structures into a cycle whose arrows
  refit when an intermediate moves or changes. Map each step, check its balance
  and carry reactant colors through the products. ChemDraw export keeps the
  reaction steps.
- **Figure panels and layouts.** Wrap a selection in a titled panel and keep
  molecules or reactions in rows, columns and grids that adjust as their
  contents change. Reference structures keep their properties while staying
  outside the reaction. Illustration objects stay outside chemical analysis.
- **Connected lab equipment.** Assemble flasks, condensers and other pieces
  by their joints, with adapters for compatible sizes. Add Schlenk and J. Young
  glassware, measuring vessels, pipettes, burettes, gas lines and tube furnaces.
  Set liquid levels, move valves, edit tube cut lengths and insert a parts list.
- **Your own equipment.** Define pieces from drawing shapes, add standard
  ground-glass joints and test their fit. Keep pieces in **My pieces**, share
  a library or link a lab folder. Equipment and libraries are preview features.
- **More editable graphics.** Draw editable tables and TLC plates with lanes,
  spots and Rf labels, import SVG artwork as editable paths, and use gradients, opacity, glowing
  highlights, shadows and wavy lines. ChemDraw exchange keeps supported styles
  and reports approximations.
- **Properties, search and export.** Properties puts the selected object's
  controls first, with names and identifiers together in **Identity**.
  **Cmd/Ctrl+K** opens command search. Export starts with destinations such as
  **Copy for Word & PowerPoint** and **Picture file**.
- **Easier GitHub browsing.** Search repositories or paste a URL above the
  repository list. Name new drawings and folders where they will appear, and
  see which shared repositories are **Read only**. New drawings open directly
  to a blank canvas.
- **Smoother editing and export.** Reuse drawing layers and placement previews,
  skip offscreen rendering work and release unused GPU images. Browser figure
  exports run in workers, and the workspace opens while recovery drafts are
  discovered in the background.

**File compatibility.** Drawings using the new drawing elements, equipment,
cycles, panels, TLC plates, tables or chosen caption decimal places use document
version 40 and need 0.17.0. Other drawings retain their required earlier document
version. Earlier drawings still open in 0.17.0.

macOS release downloads are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux downloads
remain unsigned. Windows production signing is pending.
